children.translated_text: <s>Oṃ</s>, homage to the Lord of the World! Thus

children.text: mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān potalake par
children.translated_text: have I heard. At one time the Blessed One on <s>Potalaka</s> mountain

children.text: ate viharati sma || āryāvalokiteśvarasya bhavane anekaśālat
children.translated_text: was dwelling in the abode of the noble <s>Avalokiteśvara</s>, adorned with many <s>śāla</s> trees,
<s>latā</s> (creepers), <s>tamāla</s>, <s>campaka</s>, <s>aśoka</s>, <s>atimuktaka</s> vines, and various jeweled trees, together with a great assembly of <s>bhikṣus</s>,

children.text: navanavatibhiś ca bodhisatvakoṭīniyutaśatasahasrair anekaiś ca śuddhāvāsakāyikair devaputrakoṭīniyutaśatasahasraiḥ | parivṛtaḥ puraskṛta īśvaramaheśvarabrahmakāyikān devaputrān adhikṛtya dhar
children.translated_text: ninety-nine <s>koṭis</s> of hundreds of thousands of <s>niyutas</s> of <s>bodhisattvas</s>, and many hundreds of thousands of <s>koṭis</s> of <s>niyutas</s> of <s>devaputras</s> (sons of the gods) from the <s>Śuddhāvāsa</s> (Pure Abodes), surrounded and honored. He was teaching the <s>Dharma</s> with reference to <s>Īśvara</s>, <s>Maheśvara</s>, and the <s>Brahmakāyika</s> <s>devaputras</s>,

children.text: an deśayati sma || atha khalv āryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisatvo mahāsatva utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yena bhagavāṃs tenāñjaliṃ kṛtvā praṇamya prahasitavadano bhūtvā bhagavantam etad avocat ||
children.translated_text: teaching the <s>Dharma</s>. Then the noble <s>Avalokiteśvara</s>, the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s>, rising from his seat, arranging his upper robe over one shoulder, placing his right knee on the ground, joining his palms toward the Blessed One, bowing, and with a smiling face, said this to the Blessed One:

children.text: asti mama bhagavann amoghapāśarājaṃ nāma hṛdayaṃ yan mayā pūr

am ekanavatime kalpe vilokitāyāṃ lokadhātau lokendrarājasya tathāgatasya sakāśād udgṛhītaṃ yena me bhagavann īśvaramaheśvaradevaputrapramukhāni bahūni śuddhāvāsakāyikadevaputrapramukhāny anekāni devaputraśatasahasrāṇi samādāpitāny anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau || asaṃmohajñānavyūhapramukhāni ca mayā daśasamādhiśatasahasrāṇi pratilabdhāni | yasmiṃś ca punar bhagavan pṛthivīpradeśe | idam amoghapāśahṛdayaṃ pracaret || veditavyaṃ bhagavans tasmin pṛthivīpradeśe | īśvaramaheśvarabrahmakāyikapramukhāni dvādaśadevaputraśatasahasrāṇi rakṣāvaraṇaguptaye sthāsyanti || caityasa
children.translated_text: in the ninety-first <s>kalpa</s> (aeon), in the world-realm called <s>Vilokitā</s>, received from the <s>Tathāgata</s> <s>Lokendrarāja</s>. By this, O Blessed One, I have established many hundreds of thousands of <s>devaputras</s> headed by <s>Īśvara</s> and <s>Maheśvara</s>, and many hundreds of thousands of <s>devaputras</s> from the <s>Śuddhāvāsa</s> realms, in unsurpassed perfect awakening.

children.text: mato bhagavan sa pṛthivīpradeśo bhaviṣyati | yatredam amoghapāśahṛdaya
children.translated_text: O Blessed One, that region of the earth shall be blessed where this <s>Amoghapāśa</s> <s>hṛdaya</s>

'I have, O Blessed One, a <s>hṛdaya</s> (heart-spell) called <s>Amoghapāśarāja</s> (King of the Unfailing Noose), which I formerly

if such a one should feel remorse, in the future he enters upon

children.translated_text: the discipline. For such a one, O Blessed One, through a single day's fasting and recitation, in this very lifetime that <s>karma</s>

children.translated_text: with equanimous contemplation, free from the five aggregates (<s>skandhas</s>). Then from the ten directions, a thousand <s>Buddhas</s> shall cause them to behold [the Buddhas] face to face, and shall cause them to see their transgressions. [Abbreviated.] Until, having written it in a book and placed it in their house,

children.translated_text: for that person, O Blessed One, in this very visible existence, twenty benefits are to be expected.

Whoever, O Blessed One — whether a son of good family or a daughter of good family, a <s>bhikṣu</s> or <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, a male lay-follower or a female lay-follower, or any other being — should observe a fast on the bright eighth day dedicated to the <s>Amoghapāśa</s> <s>hṛdaya</s>, and recite the <s>Amoghapāśa</s> <s>hṛdaya</s> seven times without speaking,

(17) No fear of <s>kākhordas</s> (demonic afflictions), no fear of <s>ḍākinīs</s>, and they shall not have intense <s>kleśas</s> (afflictions) and secondary afflictions.

(20) Wherever they are reborn, there they shall never be separated from loving-kindness (<s>maitrī</s>), compassion (<s>karuṇā</s>), sympathetic joy (<s>muditā</s>), and equanimity (<s>upekṣā</s>).

(1) He will show a bright face [at death].
(2) He will die in comfort.
(3) He will not have confused views.
(4) He will not make hand-gestures. He will not make foot-gestures. He will not die having soiled the bed with excrement and urine.
(5) He will have well-established mindfulness.
(6) He will not die face-downward.

Because <s>bodhisattva</s>s are free from defilement and jealousy, envy has departed. <s>Buddhahood</s> (<s>buddha-bodhi</s>) is attained precisely through benefiting beings. One enters the assembly of <s>bodhisattva</s>s. <s>Bodhi</s> is called <s>Prajñā</s> (wisdom). <s>Satva</s> is called <s>Upāya</s> (skillful means). These two <s>Dhar</s>-

children.translated_text: Then the Blessed One said this to the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> Noble <s>Avalokiteśvara</s>:

children.text: bhāṣa tvaṃ śuddhasatva | yasyedānīṃ kālaṃ manyase || anumoditaṃ tathāgatena paścime kāle paścime samaye bodhisatvayānikānāṃ pitṛkāryaṃ kariṣyati ||
children.translated_text: 'Speak, O Pure Being! Now is the time you deem fit.' The <s>Tathāgata</s> has given approval. In the last time, in the final age, it will serve as a father's duty for those of the <s>bodhisattva</s> vehicle.

children.translated_text: Then the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> Noble <s>Avalokiteśvara</s>, with unblinking eyes, said this to the Blessed One:
